scope: Shared v4 thumbnail Dock disclosure. Full component controls and original models remain intact. This review does not close final startup, CPU4 motion or broader manual accessibility acceptance.

design.handoff: CODEX_HANDOFF_3.md section 3.9: at most two visible thumbnail pills
design.stageKit: Up to three declared/direct actions in full views
design.assets: Existing Kit geometry and tokens; no new artwork

change.thumbnail: When three actions are actually visible, retain the first and a More disclosure containing the other two original buttons.
change.full: Preserve original direct buttons and component-owned hidden actions.
change.ownership: One delegated document UI owner; per-Stage visibility observer disconnects on runtime disposal. No global Stage reference.
change.keyboard: Enter/Space toggle, Arrow keys/Home/End navigate, Escape closes, Tab exits normally. Canceled Space cannot reopen. UI-owned keys retain their releases without stealing keys begun in the component.
change.targets: 28px visual More pill with a physical 44px hit area; overflow rows at least 44px.
change.portable: The generator includes the same helper; normal portable full exports keep direct actions.

actualComponents.preparation: Runtime held, fonts/images ready, existing finite CSS transitions observed until finished or paused. Dock hidden on both image sides. Exact PNG bytes, root DOM, geometry, original button objects/names/state and source time are compared.
actualComponents.gpu: Disabled only for deterministic artwork roundtrips; no timing claim.

input.nativeExportMethod: For test-only native contexts, replace the single exact full bootstrap with thumb; component source remains unchanged.

fixedNames.oracle: Actual Chromium accessibility tree and complete visible-caption aliases; original hidden-action behavior preserved.

retainedFindings.finding: More Space then Escape then release reopened the disclosure.
retainedFindings.status: Fixed and covered in normal/reduced keyboard tests.
retainedFindings.evidence: probe.log; probe-cancel-fix.log. The probe image/result were overwritten by the second run; the first log remains.

retainedFindings.finding: Menu keydowns leaked to a parent Stage handler (14 observed).
retainedFindings.status: Fixed with capture-phase UI ownership and release tracking; tests also preserve a key begun outside the UI.

retainedFindings.finding: Source sound models can handle trusted clicks in Stage capture before the button listener.
retainedFindings.status: The baseline independently demonstrates document=1, Stage=1 and target callbacks=0. Verification observes actual original delegated paths rather than forcing target delivery.
retainedFindings.evidence: baseline-delegation witness retained in the private phase.

retainedFindings.finding: Error Shake initialization runs six CSS transitions while the source clock is held.
retainedFindings.status: OPEN: pre-existing initialization/hold issue. Dock artwork comparisons explicitly cover settled held states and do not claim first-frame equivalence.
retainedFindings.evidence: shake-probe states; initial comparison differed at 197 pixels, maximum channel delta 94, bounds [86,76,286,120]. Later settled A/A and old/new pairs are exact.

retainedFindings.finding: Initial verifier assumptions failed for missing base URL, hidden Cassette controls and hidden full Zippo Press.
retainedFindings.status: Harness corrected; all failures retained. Declaring three actions does not establish three visible actions.

interruptedColdRoutes.status: Interrupted before completion to fix the thumbnail Dock requirement; V29 evidence frozen and read/copy only.
interruptedColdRoutes.method: Fresh browser process per component; eight fresh contexts covering desktop/mobile, dark/light, cold/warm. Process-first cold outliers and partial attempt retained.
interruptedColdRoutes.acceptance: No all-catalog startup pass. Prior misses remain evidence; restart final measurements on the corrected stable source.
